sections.title: Project overview
sections.content:
Build a website for our small bakery so customers can browse the menu and place cake orders online
Target audience: local families and small offices in our town who order celebration cakes for birthdays and other events

sections.title: Key details
sections.content:
Deliverables:
- menu page
- online order form with checkout
- contact page
Deadline: 2026-11-02
Budget: $3,000, already approved
Constraints:
- checkout goes through a third-party payment processor, not a custom payment system
- clean and minimal style using our existing logo colors of navy and cream
